task.title: Compare Changes Before Committing
task.shortdesc: See exactly what changed in a file (including images) before you stage or commit.

step.cmd:
In the
or
area, double-click a file.

result.p: The compare editor opens and highlights the differences between your version and the last committed version. A newly added file has no earlier version to compare against, so double-clicking it opens the file instead.
result.note: For image files (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, and other raster formats), the Git Client opens a side-by-side image comparison with the newer version on the left and the older version on the right. SVG files are treated as XML, so they open in the regular text comparison (where you can switch to Author mode to see them rendered).
